full_judgment: "Pre-emption was disallowed in that case on reversal of the High Court Division's decision as the pre-emptor was not found to have owned any land contiguous to the land transferred. Rule of bar of partial pre-emption was discussed in both the cases referred to above and it was held that this rule is applicable to a case where pre-emption is soughs by a co-sharer tenant who is required to pre-empt the entire land transferred, but is not applicable in a case where a contiguous land holder seeks pre-emption and contiguity being the only basis for his claim. He may pre-empt only that part of the land transferred to which his land is contiguous unless the land transferred is a compact block of area."
